title: deployment-compliance-preflight-and-exception-authorizations
content:
Purpose:
This working document is a preflight checklist and exception authorization template for releases that modify RBAC v2 roles/policies, change audit log schemas, update SIEM export mappings, or touch automated evidence collection. It is intended to be completed by the owning engineering/product team, reviewed by Security/Compliance, and to capture any authorized deviations and compensating controls.

Scope:
- Applies to hosted API and Dedicated cluster releases that: modify role definitions or role bindings (RBAC v2), change audit log field names or schema shapes, alter SIEM export mappings or topics, or change evidence-automation hooks that collect deployment artifacts.
- Out of scope: minor config tweaks that do not touch RBAC, audit schema, SIEM exports, or evidence automation.

How to use:
1) Owning team fills sections A-D and attaches/links artifacts in linked_artifacts.
2) Security reviews, adds comments, and either signs off or records an exception using section E.
3) If exception is granted, the exception block must list compensating controls, an expiry date, and required evidence before expiry.

A. Deployment summary (owner to provide)
- Service / repo: infra/deployments/service-x
- Change summary: add RBAC v2 bindings for proxy routing, rename audit field user_id to actor.id, add SIEM mapping to index actor.id as user.identifier, add evidence upload hook to s3://redwood-evidence/2025-11-*/
- Deploy window: 2025-11-24 02:00-04:00 UTC
- Rollout strategy: canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 15 minute observation windows and auto-rollback on sustained error-rate > 2x baseline
- PR / CI: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/452

B. Security checklist (answer Y/N + notes)
1) RBAC v2 changes reviewed by IAM owner? (required)  Y
   Notes: new roles proxy.traffic.reader and proxy.traffic.writer added with least-privilege assertions.
2) Role bindings scoped to namespaces and service accounts? (required)  Y
3) Compatibility plan for legacy roles/tokens documented? (recommended)  Y
   Notes: migration shim for legacy tokens active for 30 days.
4) Audit schema changes documented and migration plan exists? (required)  Y
   Notes: rename user_id -> actor.id handled by transformation layer for 14 days. Schema file uploaded.
5) SIEM export mapping updated and tested in staging? (required)  Y
   Notes: staging test ID SIEM-TEST-2025-11-10; mapping validated for Splunk ingest mapping actor.id -> user.identifier.
6) Evidence automation hook updated and smoke-tested? (recommended)  Y
   Notes: evidence-collector smoke run returned success HTTP 200.
7) KMS/HSM keys for audit/evidence storage exist and rotation policy confirmed? (required)  Y
   Notes: KMS key projects/redwood/keys/audit-2024, rotation 90 days.
8) Backfill/transform for historical logs completed prior to deploy? (recommended)  N
   Notes: backfill scheduled post-deploy, ETA 72 hours. Risk: historic queries using old field name may show gaps.
9) Monitoring and alerting updated for new field names and counts? (required)  Y
   Notes: dashboard observability/alerts/audit-schema-v2 and alert audit-field-missing-rate threshold set to 0.5%.
10) Privacy and retention impact reviewed? (required)  Y

C. Evidence automation (owner to attach run outputs)
- Evidence hook path: infra/evidence/hooks/deploy-audit-snapshot.sh
- Smoke run: evidence-collector --run --since=2025-11-12T00:00Z --dry-run -> uploader returned 200 OK
- Artifact naming convention: evidence/deploys/{deploy-id}/audit-snapshot-YYYYMMDDTHHMMZ.jsonl.gzip
- Retention label: evidence-retention:90d applied
- Object immutability: S3 object lock (compliance mode) enabled on redwood-evidence-prod

D. SIEM export and audit schema technical notes
- Audit schema location: s3://redwood-logs-prod/audit-schema-v2.json (sha256: abc123...)
- Field rename strategy: user_id rewritten to actor.id by infra/logging/transformers/audit-transformer; transformer supports passthrough flag to fall back to legacy shape.
- SIEM topics: audit-raw (Kinesis), audit-enriched (Firehose -> Splunk)
- Transport and encryption: TLS in transit and KMS encryption with key projects/redwood/keys/siem-export
- Estimated additional ingestion cost during backfill: approximately $90/day for ~72 hours

E. Exception authorization template (complete only if any required item is N or partial)
- Exception id: EXC-2025-11-12-01
- Items needing exception: Backfill/transform not completed prior to deploy (Checklist B8)
- Requested deviation: proceed with deploy while performing backfill post-deploy within 72 hours, accepting temporary query gaps for historical data
- Compensating controls: 1) Dashboards annotated with schema-migration: in-progress; 2) Query service exposes a rate-limited compatibility endpoint for legacy queries; 3) Dedicated on-call engineer assigned to monitor SIEM backfill and query impact
- Risk level: Medium
- Expiry / review date: 2025-11-27
- Evidence required before expiry: backfill job completion report and sample transformed rows, SIEM ingestion logs showing transformed events

Approvals (typed names and dates acceptable)
- Owner (engineering): Maya Thompson  2025-11-12
- IAM reviewer: Jared Liu  2025-11-13
- SIEM/Logging SME: Priya Nair  2025-11-14
- Security & Compliance approver: Ethan Brooks  2025-11-15

If exception approved:
- Exception approver (Security Director): Lena Ortiz  2025-11-16
- CRO/Head of Product notified: Arjun Mehta  2025-11-16 (acknowledged)

F. Rollback and mitigation runbook (high level)
1) Abort canary promotion and scale to previous ReplicaSet: kubectl rollout undo deploy/service-x -n prod
2) If audit-schema mismatch observed, set transformer to passthrough and enable legacy mapping flag: infra/logging/transformers/set-legacy=true
3) If evidence upload fails, disable evidence hook via configmap evidence-hook-config and run manual evidence collection: evidence-collector --run --since=2025-11-12T00:00Z --output=s3://redwood-evidence/manual/

G. Post-deploy verification (owner to confirm within 24 hours of 100% rollout)
- SIEM ingestion success rate >= 99% for audit-enriched topic
- No sustained error-rate increase on canary hosts (>2x baseline)
- Backfill job initiated and first 10k rows transformed (if applicable)
- Evidence artifacts present in S3 with object lock flags
- IAM audit logs show expected new role usage and no unexpected unbound permissions

H. Open questions and notes
- Notify query/analytics owners about the 72 hour potential gap via #ops-audit-migrations Slack channel.
- Consider adding a temporary compatibility lambda to rewrite legacy queries at the query layer to reduce user impact.
- Schedule audit retention policy review: 2025-12-02

Attachments required before final signoff:
- PR diff: github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/452
- Audit schema JSON: s3://redwood-logs-prod/audit-schema-v2.json
- SIEM mapping test logs: SIEM-TEST-2025-11-10.log (attach to Drive)

Change log (this Drive doc)
- 2025-11-12: created by Maya Thompson
- 2025-11-13: IAM notes added by Jared Liu
- 2025-11-14: SIEM test logs attached by Priya Nair
- 2025-11-20: exception block refined by Ethan Brooks

Contact and escalation
- Security on-call: security-oncall@redwood.ai
- Slack pager: #sec-oncall

End of document.
